title: feat(console): clear the value saved beneath an env pin in Setup
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoVUxqTWaM6rFCGZo1WDXBGb)_

Fixes #30665

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Setup 设置页里被环境变量锁定的字段,若锁下面还存着一个保存值(在本页写入的那一层),该行会说明"环境变量的值仍然生效",并提供"清除保存的值"按钮;确认后只对这一个键写 `null`。
- 为什么改:#30385 裁决 A 第 5 项:管理员用环境变量锁定(如 `OS_AUTH_ALLOWED_IP_RANGES`)来自救后,以前在 Setup 里删不掉锁下面的旧值,一旦移除变量旧值就回来;服务端的清除(#30448)和"锁下是否有存值"的读数(#30823)都已落地,这里补上界面。
- 风险与回滚:只动 Console 设置页与语言包四个新键;按钮只在"锁定 + 本层确有存值"时出现,确认后才写,页面草稿不受影响;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx`(`storedBeneathPin` 与 `ClearSavedBeneathPin`)、`SettingsView.tsx`(`onClearSaved`)、`__tests__/SettingsView.clearBeneathPin-30665.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.clearBeneathPin-30665.test.tsx`,预期 7/7 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`SettingsField.tsx`:** `storedBeneathPin(resolved, writeScope)` reads the server's `cascadeChain` alone: true when the row is env-pinned (`locked`, `source: 'env'`) and an entry beneath the `env` entry at the scope this page writes carries a non-null value (a secret's entry is the read mask, which counts). On such a row, and only when the host passes `onClearSaved`, the row draws one line ("A value is also saved here. The environment value stays in force; ...") and a "Clear the saved value" button. The button opens a confirm (title and action "Clear the saved value", body saying the saved value will not come back when the variable is removed and the environment value stays in force; Cancel is the shared `actionConfirm.cancel`). Drawn under the control for every input row and under the help text for a toggle row.
- **`SettingsView.tsx`:** `onClearSaved(key)` writes `PUT /api/settings/:namespace` with `{ [key]: null }` for that key alone, merges the read-back, toasts "Saved value cleared" and reads the namespace again. The page draft is not touched: the row is read-only, so the clear is not one of the page's edits. A refusal toasts the server's sentence (the pin never refuses a clear, so `lockedByEnv` would misname a row lock or a 403).
- **`@object-ui/i18n`:** four `console.settingsView` keys (`savedBeneathPin`, `clearSaved`, `clearSavedConfirm`, `savedCleared`) in all eleven packs (since #30902 merged: `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant` and `pt-BR` replace `zh` and `pt`). Wording clears the saved value and never says delete.
- **`.changeset/30665-clear-saved-beneath-env-pin.md`:** `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

What the server serves, measured on `origin/main` `41dc302496` before the first edit:

- The namespace read (`getNamespace` → `resolveMany(..., beneathPins = true)`) answers a pinned key `{ source: 'env', locked: true, cascadeChain: [env entry (effective), ...stored cascade beneath] }` via `withStoredBeneath`; the entries beneath lose `effective` and end with the `default` entry. A pinned key whose env value is null keeps its one `env` entry. A secret beneath the pin is `storedSecretPresence` on the service and masked entry by entry by `redactSecretValues` on the route, so the console sees the mask or `null`.
- The clear (`setMany`, the `[#30385]` block): `null` / `undefined` for a key an in-force override pins passes the `SettingsLockedError` check and is judged by the row locks and write predicates like any clear; it writes at the key's registered scope (`spec.scope ?? manifest.scope ?? 'tenant'`), the same derivation the page passes as `writeScope`. So the control is gated on an entry at that scope: a value stored only at another rung could not be removed by this clear, and no control is drawn for it.

No new server field is needed; no file under `packages/**` changes.

## Tests

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.clearBeneathPin-30665.test.tsx` (7 tests, whole page over a stubbed `fetch` and the real `../api`):

- the control appears on exactly the three pinned rows with a value stored at the write scope (text, masked secret, toggle) and not on a pinned row with nothing stored, a pinned row stored only above the write scope, or an unpinned row;
- the line and the confirm say the environment value stays in force and never say delete;
- confirm sends exactly `{"allowed_ip_ranges":null}`, toasts, and the row stays locked and read-only with no control left after the server's answer;
- a masked secret's clear sends `{"webhook_secret":null}`;
- Cancel sends nothing;
- an unsaved edit elsewhere stays in the draft and is not sent;
- a refused clear toasts the server's sentence and keeps the control.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs on head (see the report comment for the final sha)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/` → Test Files 38 passed (38), Tests 304 passed (304).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` → Test Files 97 passed (97), Tests 1521 passed, 13 skipped (key parity across all ten packs included; on head fb666f8d after merging main: settings + i18n 136/136 files, 1949 passed, 13 skipped, eleven-pack parity included).
- Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, source is what the console project resolves): the write-scope condition in `storedBeneathPin` widened to any stored rung → 2 failed / 5 passed (the offer test and the clear test, both seeing the extra control on the tenant row stored only at global); restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): every line run with stdin closed; exit codes in the report comment, reconciled with `--ran`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The clear writes at once after its own confirm rather than through the page's Save bar. A pinned row is read-only, so a pending clear would have to draw a value the row never shows; the confirm is the row's own question, like an `action_button`'s `confirmText`.
- The `i18n-locale-en` chunk gains four strings; its per-chunk ceiling is unchanged. The eager-closure budget is weighed by CI's `Build & E2E UI` job (`pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure`), not re-run locally.
- The first-run checklist renders `SettingsField` without `onClearSaved`, so it shows no control.
